verdict.rationale: Chronicle is an agent simulation and evaluation platform, so background automation applies mainly to evaluation runs and agent monitoring. Its marketing llms.txt claims "real-time monitoring of production agents with autonomous fix and rollback". The docs mention automating workflows via SDKs in several languages, CI-scoped API keys for unattended runs, and retry-safe idempotent calls. Missing for 10: documented scheduling or trigger configuration for background automations, in-depth docs for the autonomous monitoring/fix/rollback feature beyond a one-line marketing claim, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
